RAJYA SABHA 
Monday, the 28th February, 2011/9th Phalguna, 1932 (Saka) 
The House met at thirty minutes past one of the clock, 
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair. 
THE BUDGET GENERAL, 2011-12 
MR. CHAIRMAN : The Budget (General), 2011-12. Shri Pranab Mukherjee. 
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE (SHRI PRANAB MUKHERJEE) : Sir, I lay on the 
Table, a statement (in English and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and 
expenditure of the Government for the year 2011- 12. [Placed in Library. 
See No. L.T. 3913/15/11] 
_______ 
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2001-12 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Now, the Fiscal Policy Statements, 2011-12. 
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE (SHRI PRANAB MUKHERJEE) : Sir, I lay on the 
Table, under sub- section (1) of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility 
and Budget Management Act, 2003, a copy each (in English and Hindi) of 
the following papers:- 
(i) the macro-economic framework statement; 
(ii) the medium-term fiscal policy statement; and 
(iii) the fiscal policy strategy statement. [Placed in Library. 
See No. L.T. 3913A/15/11] 
MR. CHAIRMAN : The House stands adjourned till 1100 hours on Tuesday, 
the 1st March, 2011. 
The House then adjourned at thirty-one minutes past one of the clock  
till eleven of the clock on Tuesday, the 1st March, 2011
